findings.title: Catalogue layer_on/layer_off actions do not synchronize the macOS navigation wheel owner
guarantees: The navigation layer wheel and keyboard bindings follow the same accepted activation/deactivation action.
A successful layer_off must not leave wheel events consumed by the layer.

reproduction.observed: layer_on requests layer_active=1 but wheel passes scroll; after F20 entry, layer_off requests layer_active=0 but wheel still posts SOUND_UP; F19 control fixes the same owner.
reproduction.boundaries: Actual production action registry, wheel owner and sentinel owner; mocked accepted Karabiner variable-write boundary and Hammerspoon event/timer APIs. No native macOS execution.

findings.root_cause: macos/modules/gestures/actions.lua:966-972 writes layer_active through ke_variables.set without completion/state publication; macos/modules/shortcuts/actions/system.lua:1048 tracks layer_held only from F20/F19 generator sentinels. CLI variable writes produce no sentinel.
findings.silent_failure: The action and native variable write can succeed without any error while wheel behavior disagrees with the keyboard navigation layer.
findings.regression_test: Compose real action registry and wheel owner; assert entry from layer_on and exit from layer_off after exact-generation successful write, plus refused and superseded writes. Existing probe-gesture-wheel.lua supplies both failing behaviors and a healthy sentinel control.
